name: Brine
summary: On Blackthorn Ridge, Brine guides shaman initiates toward the spirits of water. This orc shaman teaches them to commune with the tides and earn their Water Totem.

sections.title: Hermit of the Ridge
sections.body: Brine lives on a hill in northern Blackthorn Ridge, far from the Barrens' trading posts. Though dry savannas surround her, she has devoted her life to understanding water. Shaman across the Horde seek her wisdom after mastering earth and fire. She teaches that water calls for patience and perspective, qualities few understand as deeply as she does.

sections.title: Memories of the Eastern Kingdoms
sections.body: In her youth, Brine marched with her orc companions across the Hillsbrad Foothills and fought against human settlements. During the campaign, she came to Tarren Mill and found a humble well fed by fresh spring water. The well stayed in her memory as a sign of life amid devastation. It strengthened a lesson she had learned as a child: even in the darkest sorrow, a small token of hope can still be found.

sections.title: The Call of Water
sections.body: Brine tests aspiring shaman with pilgrimages to gather pure droplets from varied sources. Her trials teach that water can be gentle yet unyielding. In her rituals, shaman commune with the elemental spirits and bind water's restorative essence to their totemic focus.

faq.answer: Brine is an experienced orc shaman who lives alone on a hill in northern Blackthorn Ridge, in the southern Barrens. She guides initiates seeking communion with water spirits.

faq.q: Why is a water shaman living in a desert?
aliases: why does brine live in the desert
faq.answer: The Barrens are dry, but Brine's solitude lets her commune deeply with the elements, away from the noise of settlements.

faq.q: What is Brine's connection to Tarren Mill?
faq.answer: Years ago, Brine fought alongside Horde warriors in the Hillsbrad Foothills and entered Tarren Mill. There she found a small well of pure spring water, a lasting sign of life and hope amid the ruin of war.

faq.q: What role does Brine play in shaman training?
faq.answer: Brine guides initiates through stages of the Call of Water trials. She sends them to gather pure water from varied sources and teaches them humility and resilience before they gain the insight needed for their Water Totem.
Brine lives atop a high bluff in northern Blackthorn Ridge, in the southern Barrens, just north of Razorfen Kraul.
Brine teaches that even in pain and sorrow, hope and renewal can be found. Water represents life and perseverance through harsh trials.

angles.text: Brine guides you through trials of endurance and spirit before you can commune with water and claim your Water Totem.
A veteran of the wars in Hillsbrad, Brine serves the Horde by passing the spiritual heritage of the elements to new generations.
